scope: Complete chapter 8 lexical support: all 284 fixed objects S1770–S2053 / 107 pairs MTP-000568–MTP-000674 reviewed against actual English and all 69 translator notes.
policy: Compact records group actual source loci and reader-linked local notes. All provisional usages remain proposed. Unrendered unresolved Tibetan is retained in the relevant construction record and receives no invented lexical equivalent. Routine canonical repetitions and ordinary function words are excluded unless a material disclosed construction requires review.
